examples.title: A toy train through a miniature town
examples.description: An animated Blender scene controls token allocation through time. The train, houses, and trees receive fine 1×1 tokens; the ground and tracks use 2×2, and uniform sky uses 4×4.

settings.prompt: A charming realistic miniature red toy locomotive pulling two passenger carriages, blue and yellow, winds smoothly around a curved railway through a handcrafted miniature town. The train rolls continuously forward with rotating wheels and carriages following the curve. Small cream houses with red roofs, tiny windows, green model trees, wooden sleepers and steel rails surround the track. A low foreground house briefly occludes part of the passing train. The camera tracks smoothly alongside the train and gently lowers, revealing changing angles of the locomotive and the town with clear parallax. Warm daylight, believable miniature materials, stable geometry, one continuous shot, no cuts, no reversal, no text or logos. The locomotive leads exactly two passenger carriages, maintaining consistent spacing and proportions around the bend. Detailed handcrafted house facades, roof tiles, miniature trees and carriage windows remain stable as the camera follows. The sky is clear and uniform.

examples.title: A conversation in a restaurant
examples.description: Two people exchange gestures across a restaurant table as the camera moves around their booth. The animated scene assigns fine tokens to the people and small table objects, and 2×2 tokens to the furniture and background. This result uses 2×2 as the coarsest level, including the sky outside the window.

settings.prompt: A realistic live-action continuous two-shot of two adults sitting opposite each other in a cozy retro diner booth, having a relaxed conversation over coffee. One adult sits on the left wearing a teal shirt; the other sits on the right wearing a cream shirt. Both remain seated in the same positions throughout. During the first half, the teal-shirted adult makes one small natural hand gesture while speaking and then lowers the hand toward the table; the cream-shirted adult listens and nods gently. During the second half, the cream-shirted adult responds with a small hand gesture while the other listens. Two white ceramic coffee mugs, a sugar jar and a metal napkin holder remain on the wooden table. Red upholstered booth seats, a black-and-cream checkerboard floor and a large daylight window overlooking distant buildings fill the scene. The camera makes one smooth pronounced arc across the front of the booth from a wider left-oblique view to a closer right-oblique view, moving gently inward and downward, with visible parallax between the people, table, booth backs and window. Both people remain in frame; the camera stays on the same side of the conversation axis. Natural adult body proportions and hands, small expressive head movements, warm soft daylight, grounded contact with seats and floor, stable furniture, one uninterrupted shot at real-time speed.

examples.title: A platformer jump between floating islands
examples.description: Animated bounding boxes specify a player running, jumping between floating islands, and landing, with a third-person camera following directly behind. The player and all islands receive fine tokens; the ground plane uses 2×2 and the uniform sky uses 4×4.

settings.prompt: A continuous third-person fantasy platformer gameplay shot, viewed directly from behind a single nimble adventurer wearing a teal jacket, tan trousers and brown boots. The full body stays visible near the center as the adventurer runs forward away from the camera across a grassy floating island, bends the knees and pushes off at the edge, jumps across an open gap in a clear rising and falling arc, then lands feet-first on the next floating island, absorbs the impact with bent knees and takes a recovery step. Show coordinated running legs, swinging arms, changing posture during flight and a grounded landing. A smooth chase camera follows directly behind and slightly above the player, looking ahead toward the landing island and gently following the jump height. Detailed grassy ledges, rocky island undersides and small bushes; several other floating islands remain visible around the route. Far below the floating islands lies a broad, smooth ground plane with a uniform muted sandy-beige color, a matte finish, gentle lighting gradients and soft shadows. The ground has very little visible texture: no grass, gravel, pebbles, cracks, tiles or repeating patterns. A clear uniform blue sky surrounds the islands. Polished stylized 3D game visuals, warm daylight, stable environment geometry, natural gravity, one uninterrupted shot.

examples.title: A girl playing with a corgi
examples.description: Moving detail regions follow the girl and corgi, while the garden and sky receive different background allocations.

settings.prompt: A continuous live-action video showing a little girl and a Pembroke Welsh corgi actively playing in a sunny park. Locked-off wide camera, full bodies visible throughout. On the left, the girl in a red pinafore and cream shirt starts crouching, rises to a half-standing position while lifting both arms excitedly, then bends her knees and crouches again, reaching forward and laughing. On the right, the golden-and-white corgi trots several steps left toward a small red ball in the lower center, makes a clear little upward hop with its paws leaving the ground, lands, and bounces forward again. Show visible coordinated leg movement, changing body height, swinging arms, and bouncing ears and fur throughout the shot. The girl stays in the left third while the corgi moves within the right half, with a little space between them. Natural anatomy and fluid energetic motion. Textured green grass, yellow and white foreground wildflowers in both lower corners, a hedge and leafy trees across the middle background, a slender tree trunk at the far right. Smooth pale blue sky in the upper fifth. Warm morning light, realistic shadows. No cuts or zoom, no text or watermark.

examples.title: A dress twirl on a garden terrace
examples.description: Moving detail regions cover the woman and flowing skirt; static fine regions cover both complete plants, including their foliage and pots.

settings.prompt: Full-body realistic video of one naturally proportioned adult woman doing a light, lively twirl on a sunlit stone garden terrace. She wears a simple sleeveless coral-red summer dress: a fitted bodice at her natural waist and a single flowing knee-length skirt. Her bare shoulders, bare arms, bare hands and bare lower legs are clearly visible. She has a normal adult head-to-body ratio and slender natural arms. Both empty hands are relaxed, fingers gently curved, held away from her waist and skirt. She takes small grounded pivoting steps, turns her shoulders and hips through a side view and continues turning, then eases into a balanced stance. Her elbows bend naturally as her arms open and draw closer. The skirt lifts outward with the turn and falls in soft folds as she slows; her dark hair follows the motion. A fixed wide camera shows her entire body and cream flat shoes with space above her head and below her feet. Two terracotta flower pots stand near the far left and right edges; a low stone wall and green shrubs form a stable background beneath a narrow strip of clear blue sky. Warm natural daylight, coherent anatomy, real-time movement, one continuous shot.
